evidence: Paper Invest Basic is officially $0/month free forever and includes API & MCP access; no credit card is required to obtain the free API key.

Paper's official developer page documents GET /v1/market-data/quote/{symbol} as a real-time NBBO quote with bid/ask sizes and documents a separate GET /v1/market-data/trade/{symbol} last-trade endpoint.

Paper's official MCP server README describes paper.quote(symbol) as a real-time NBBO quote and proxies the official Paper market-data API; scheduler/API callability is technically plausible using a dedicated API key/JWT.

The REST quote and REST trade objects each expose a timestamp field, giving a technically promising path to separate quote/trade timestamps, but public docs do not explicitly define those timestamps as independent upstream quote-event and trade-event timestamps rather than service timestamps. Same-run RTH live validation is still required.

Basic plan excludes WebSocket market-data streaming; REST/API access remains documented on Basic. Do not infer free WebSocket entitlement from older/marketing wording because the dedicated WebSocket page explicitly requires PRO.

Public official docs repeatedly call the quote NBBO, but no primary-source Paper document found so far identifies the upstream CTA/UTP SIP or licensed consolidated redistributor lineage. Strict G9-A therefore remains unproven under XRAY's evidence rule.

No primary-source Paper market-data license/terms evidence found so far that explicitly grants this exact automated/non-display NBBO use with all upstream exchange/vendor fees absorbed at permanent $0. Free API pricing alone does not satisfy strict G9-C.
exact_provider_question: For the Basic/free API, are the bid/ask values returned by GET /v1/market-data/quote/{symbol} the live consolidated U.S. National Best Bid and Offer sourced from CTA/UTP SIP or an identified licensed consolidated redistributor? Does `timestamp` represent the quote event time, while GET /v1/market-data/trade/{symbol}.timestamp independently represents the trade event time? Finally, does the Basic/free REST/MCP entitlement explicitly cover automated/non-display use of this quote/trade data with no separate exchange/vendor fee, subscription, balance, funding, activity, account-maintenance, or per-query charge?
reopen_condition: Primary-source Paper confirmation proves exact consolidated NBBO lineage, independent upstream quote/trade event timestamp semantics, and permanent-$0 automated/non-display entitlement; then configure a dedicated read-only market-data API credential and require same-run RTH freshness/skew probe.
